mermaid:
flowchart TD
  subgraph CFG["Configuration"]
    cf["_config.yml"]
    nv["_data/navigation.yml"]
    gs["minimal-mistakes-jekyll.gemspec"]
  end
  subgraph LAY["Mise en page"]
    df["_layouts/default.html"]
    sg["_layouts/single.html"]
    hm["_layouts/home.html"]
  end
  subgraph INC["Fragments et styles"]
    hd["_includes/head.html"]
    ms["_includes/masthead.html"]
    ft["_includes/footer.html"]
    sc["_sass/minimal-mistakes.scss"]
    dk["_sass/minimal-mistakes/skins/_dark.scss"]
  end
  cf --> df
  nv --> ms
  df --> hd
  df --> ms
  df --> ft
  sg --> df
  hm --> df
  sc --> dk
  hd --> sc
  gs --> df
explication: Le thème Jekyll empile des layouts (single, home) sur default.html, qui assemble les fragments head, masthead et footer. _config.yml et navigation.yml pilotent le contenu, et les fichiers Sass avec leurs skins fournissent l'apparence.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Jekyll theme stacks layouts (single, home) on top of default.html, which assembles the head, masthead and footer fragments. _config.yml and navigation.yml drive the content, and the Sass files with their skins provide the look.
